t: Neros Technologies - SPEEDA Edge
s: Neros is an autonomous drone startup founded in 2023 by former professional drone racers Soren Monroe-Anderson and Olaf Hichwa. The company designs, manufactures, and supplies unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for military applications. Neros has developed a cost-effective drone system priced in the low four figures, aiming to compete with cheaper Chinese alternatives while using non-Chinese supply chains.
